trace.question: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.
trace.evidence: full name refers to forename+surname; Youngest racer = MAX(dob)

attempts.sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       d.nationality,
       (SELECT r.name
        FROM results res
        JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE res.driverId = d.driverId
        ORDER BY r.date, r.raceId
        LIMIT 1) AS first_race
FROM drivers d
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       d.nationality,
       (SELECT r.name
        FROM results res
        JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE res.driverId = d.driverId
        ORDER BY r.date, r.raceId
        LIMIT 1) AS first_race
FROM drivers d
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The youngest racer is Lance Stroll. He is Canadian and first joined the Chinese Grand Prix.
